title: 9th Meeting of the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee

content.string: The meeting is called to order at 1:01 PM.
That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string: That Consent Items 2.1 and 2.2 BE APPROVED.

1.title: Municipal Accommodation Tax - Tourism London Annual Report

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the City Manager, City Manager’s Office, Tourism’s London annual report on the expenditures of Municipal Accommodation Tax revenues BE RECEIVED for information.

That, pursuant to section 2.6 of the Council Procedure By-law, authorization BE GIVEN for the November 17, 2026 Inaugural Municipal Council Meeting for the 2026-2030 term to be held at RBC Place London, in order to provide sufficient capacity to permit members of the public to attend the meeting.

1.title: Not to be heard before 1:05 PM - Public Participation Meeting - 2027 Water and Wastewater Rates

motion_texts.string: it being further noted that no individuals spoke at the public participation meeting associated with this matter.
Motion to open the public participation meeting.
Motion to close the public participation meeting.

attachments.title: 2026-10-06 Staff Report - (3.1) 2027 Water and Wastewater Rates

2.title: Not to be heard before 1:05 PM - Public Participation Meeting - 2027 Amendments to Consolidated Fees and Charges By-law

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the City Clerk, with the concurrence of the Deputy City Manager, Finance Supports the proposed by-law, as appended to the staff report dated October 6, 2026, as Appendix “B” BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on October 14, 2026, to repeal By-law A-62 and replacing it with a new 2027 Consolidated Fees and Charges By-law that lists various fees and charges for services or activities provided by the City of London, including a revision to the proposed Schedule 1 appended to the staff report dated October 6, 2026, as Appendix “B”, to maintain the existing 2026 rates for City of London delivered registered and drop-in programs for individuals and families, thereby freezing those rates at the 2026 levels for 2027;

it being noted the revenue impact of maintaining the existing 2026 rates for City of London delivered registered and drop-in programs for individuals and families, thereby freezing those rates at the 2026 levels for 2027 BE REFERRED to the 2027 Budget Update process;
it being further noted that the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee received a communication dated October 6, 2026 from Mayor J. Morgan and Councillor S. Franke with respect to this matter;
it being acknowledged that no individuals spoke at the public participation meeting associated with this matter.
Motion to open the public participation meeting.
Motion to close the public participation meeting.

That, on the recommendation of the City Clerk, with the concurrence of the Deputy City Manager, Finance Supports the proposed by-law, as appended to the staff report dated October 6, 2026, as Appendix “B” BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on October 14, 2026, to repeal By-law A-62 and replacing it with a new 2027 Consolidated Fees and Charges By-law that lists various fees and charges for services or activities provided by the City of London;



it being noted that the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee received a communication dated October 6, 2026 from Mayor J. Morgan and Councillor S. Franke with respect to this matter;

That the motion BE AMENDED to revise Schedule 1 of the proposed 2027 Consolidated Fees and Charges By-law, as appended to the staff report dated October 6, 2026 as Appendix “B”, to maintain the existing 2026 rates for City of London delivered registered and drop-in programs for individuals and families, thereby freezing those rates at the 2026 levels for 2027;

 

it being noted the revenue impact of these amendments BE REFERRED to the 2027 Budget Update process.
That the motion, as amended, BE APPROVED.

attachments.title: 2026-10-06 Staff Report - (3.2) 2027 Amendments to Consolidated Fees and Charges

1.title: Delegated Authority Transparency - Councillor S. Stevenson

motion_texts.string: That the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to report back to a future meeting of the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee with a jurisdictional scan of other municipalities' best practices and recommendations on how to provide the highest level of transparency and public reporting on decisions made under our Delegation of Authority By-law.
